links.comparator_used: Vague prompt without structured elements (structured prompt bundled role, task, tone and format)
links.outcome: Clinically adequate summary rate, with hallucinations and bias, across 8 LLMs and 8 scenarios
links.effect: Clinically adequate summary 39% structured vs 9% vague; conformance to instructions comparable (64% for both); structured more likely to introduce hallucinations and bias
links.tradeoff: Structured prompt was more likely to introduce hallucinations and bias; no model reliably produced clinically usable summaries. Role was not tested in isolation from tone, task and format.
links.quote: The structured approach was more likely to produce a clinically adequate summary (39% compared to 9%) but also more likely to introduce hallucinations and bias.
